name: Mage Slayer
summary: +1 Str or Dex; foes you damage have Disadvantage to keep Concentration; once per rest, pass a failed mental save.

benefits.name: Concentration Breaker
benefits.summary: A concentrating creature you damage has Disadvantage on its save to keep Concentration.
benefits.text: When you damage a creature that is concentrating, it has Disadvantage on the saving throw it makes to maintain Concentration.

benefits.name: Guarded Mind
benefits.summary: Once per Short or Long Rest, turn a failed Int, Wis or Cha saving throw into a success.
benefits.text: If you fail an Intelligence, a Wisdom or a Charisma saving throw, you can choose to succeed instead. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you finish a Short or Long Rest.
